Restate only the main (public) question.
Compute \(34 \times 59 - 38 \times 15\).

Step 1: Calculate \(34 \times 59\).
\[34 \times 59 = 34 \times (60 - 1) = 34 \times 60 - 34 \times 1 = 2040 - 34 = 2006\]

Step 2: Calculate \(38 \times 15\).
\[38 \times 15 = 38 \times (10 + 5) = 38 \times 10 + 38 \times 5 = 380 + 190 = 570\]

Step 3: Subtract the results from Step 1 and Step 2.
\[2006 - 570 = 1436\]
